$comment: adr-review config for the portal monorepo. Copy to portal/.contramaestre/config/adrTriggers.json after install. Only difference from the shipped default is triggerPaths: the single src/** entry is replaced with frontend/src/** + backend/src/**, and the workspace package.json manifests are listed explicitly (portal is JS/TS only, so the Rust/Go/Python manifest triggers are dropped). adrLocations keeps the defaults — portal has no docs/adr/ or docs/project_notes/ yet, so the first ADR creates them; repoint them (e.g. to docs/decisions.md) if you prefer another location.
